title: Renewal Terms Across the Northbridge Clinical Packages
content:
Renewals of approvals under the Utilization Management Program follow the terms of the member's review package below.

| Review package | Renewal case may be opened from (calendar days before the current expiration date) | Renewal needs current clinical documentation of response to therapy | Minimum weight loss a weight-management GLP-1 renewal must document (fraction of baseline body weight) | Automatic renewal of chronic drugs with continuous paid claims | Drugs eligible for automatic renewal | Specialty renewals checked against dosing guidelines and documented response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Clinical Essentials | 60 | No | 0.05 (5 percent) | No | none | No |
| Northbridge Clinical Standard | 60 | No | 0.05 (5 percent) | No | none | No |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced | 45 | Yes | 0.05 (5 percent) | No | none | No |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | 45 | Yes | 0.05 (5 percent) | No | none | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | 30 | Yes | 0.05 (5 percent) | Yes | Ozempic, Mounjaro | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | 30 | Yes | 0.05 (5 percent) | Yes | Ozempic, Mounjaro | Yes |

### Training questions

**On which packages can an Ozempic approval renew without a case?** Only on Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive and Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty, where automatic renewal is switched on and Ozempic is an eligible drug, and only with continuous paid claims over the approval period.

**A member on Northbridge Clinical Advanced has an approval expiring in 50 days (hypothetical). Is a renewal case possible yet?** Not yet: that package opens the renewal window 45 days before the expiration date. On Northbridge Clinical Standard, with a 60-day window, it would be.

**What must a Wegovy renewal for weight management show?** A documented loss of at least 0.05 of baseline body weight on every package; for instance, a member whose baseline weight was 100 kg (hypothetical) needs a documented loss of at least 5 kg.
